#
# Test-runner dependencies for the Python harnesses that judge the .NET server from outside:
# the contract suite (tests/contract: pytest, httpx, argon2-cffi to seed password hashes, ruff for its
# lint), the E2E suite (tests/e2e/weir: pytest, playwright) and the packaged live audit
# (scripts/live-packaged-e2e.py: playwright). Nothing here is part of Weir itself.
#
# Hash-locked: install with
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes -r tests/requirements.txt
# Versions were carried over from the retired backend's requirements.lock (pip-compile output) when the
# Python backend was deleted (#523). To change one, update its version and every --hash line together
# (pip-compile --generate-hashes against these same top-level names reproduces the file).
#
